request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary. uses_claim must be a JSON boolean. claim_ids must be an array of integer claim numbers, never quoted strings; use an empty array when uses_claim is false.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Findings**", "2": "Our first feature ranked groups by how persistently average hours rose over the prior six available months.", "3": "It was valid, with 95% coverage, but weak: mean information coefficient about 0.05, HAC t-statistic near 1.35, not significant.", "4": "It predicted only when the common index was high and turned slightly negative when the index was low.", "5": "Overlap with base factors was low, and ranks were stable.", "6": "**Failure**", "7": "Our second submission was rejected as invalid because the blinded payload contained a forbidden name or identifier.", "8": "It used up a slot.", "9": "The exact trigger is unclear, so use neutral naming.", "10": "**Next**", "11": "Condition the hours signal on the high-index regime, respecting the index's two-month lag."}, "hypothesis": "Groups whose average hours rose in a larger share of the past six months earn higher next-month relative returns, but only when the common index is in its high regime.", "expression": "regime(persist(V01,6),\"high\")"}
